stemMd: Three boxes contain only red balls, only blue balls, and a mixture of red and blue balls respectively. Their labels Red, Blue and Mixed are all wrong. A ball drawn from the box labelled Mixed is red. What does that box contain?
explanationMd: The box labelled Mixed is not mixed. It must therefore be one of the single-colour boxes. Drawing a red ball establishes that it is the red-only box.

distractorRationale.d: A ball was drawn from it.
distractorRationale.c: Its Mixed label is known to be wrong.
distractorRationale.a: A red ball was drawn from it.
distractorRationale.e: The wrong label excludes a mixture, and the sample excludes blue-only.
